record.body:
## Rationale

Affidavit already replays claims; the gap is assembling and showing proof when a phase finishes. Orchestra owns phase-end ritual and handoff. Putting a new aff verb here would mix gate logic with UX packaging.

## Counter-argument

A new aff proof subcommand would keep human packaging next to audit/trail and work without orchestra. That splits phase-done discipline across two tools and still leaves handoff unwired.

payload.alternatives: new aff proof verb, skill-only chat dump with no record
